class_id: the field manifest's not-applicable list disagrees with spec §1.11, so the plan asks for fields that cannot exist and the page shows them
feature: scraper/config/field-manifest.json `na` per field (generated from docs/design/field-source-resolution.spec.mjs), read by the plan generator (no ask for a not-applicable field) and by web/lib/ipo-field-applicability.ts (the reader payload hides it, OD-142)
symptom: §1.11 states per IPO type which fields are NOT_APPLICABLE. The manifest rows are written field by field, so a type exception stated once in §1.11 is easily carried on some of its fields and missed on others. A missed marking means the walk keeps asking sources for a value that cannot exist (an absence the admin queue then counts) and, for a row that does hold a stray value, the page shows a field the type does not have.
first_seen: 2026-09-29 (#1293): ipos.issue_size had no not-applicable types although §1.11 says BUYBACK/TENDER have no issue size (fixed in #1327). The #1293 sweep on 2026-10-01 compared every §1.11 statement with the manifest and found 7 more, all OFS (§1.11: 'The price band, lot size, anchor and allotment fields are NOT_APPLICABLE for this type'): ipos.price_range_min, ipos.price_range_max, ipos.lot_size, ipos.allotment_date, ipo_details.basis_of_allotment_date, ipo_details.initiation_of_refunds_date, ipo_details.credit_of_shares_date; the anchor fields were already marked. RIGHTS (ipo_valuation 93-109, anchor 131-137), NCD (price band, EPS, PE, promoter holding, peers) and BUYBACK/TENDER (issue size) already agreed. Measured on ipodhan_staging (docs/design/probes/ofs-rights-applicability.out.json): 0 of 19 OFS rows hold a value in any of the 7 columns, so the change hides nothing a reader sees today.
fix_prs: #1293 PR (branch fix/matrix-keys-1186-1293-721): the 7 OFS markings added in field-source-resolution.spec.mjs, manifest and Appendix A regenerated (A.2 OFS not-applicable 35 -> 42)
detection_check: scraper/tests/unit/config/field-manifest-na-matches-spec-1-11.test.ts (pr-gate unit sweep): §1.11 transcribed statement by statement with quotes; every (field, type) pair it declares not applicable must be in the manifest's na; a group that resolves to no manifest field fails closed; self-test proves a removed marking is caught
